blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This paper extends the non-unique games framework introduced in Bandeira et al. (2020) to address symmetric structures. Precisely, we consider the problem \[ \begin{aligned}
  \underset{g_1,\ldots,g_n\in \mathcal{G}}{\operatorname{min}}\,\, \frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{i,j=1}^n \sum_{s\in S} f_{ij}(g_i s g_j^{-1}), \end{aligned} \] where $\mathcal{G}$ is a compact group, $S\subset \mathcal{G}$ is a finite subgroup of symmetry elements, and $f_{ij}:\mathcal{G}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is a loss function. A notable example is common lines based orientation estimation of cryo-EM images for molecules with point group symmetry $S$, where $\mathcal{G}$ is the rotation group $\operatorname{SO}(3)$. With a semidefinite programming relaxation, we turn the problem into a convex program that is solved with the alternating direction method of multipliers. Unlike existing approaches which are tailored to specific symmetry groups, ours provides a unified computational framework for addressing all point group symmetries. We demonstrate the applicability of the proposed algorithm on the cryo-EM orientation estimation problem on both simulated and experimental datasets. In particular, our algorithm is effective in generating high-quality ab initio models from only a few class averages computed from experimental images.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has emerged as a powerful technique for determining the three-dimensional structures of macromolecules at near atomic resolution ( Wang and Sigworth, 2006 , Frank, 2006 , Nakane et al., 2020 , Yip et al., 2020 ) .
Symmetry, a fundamental feature of nature, is pervasive in the structural organization of protein molecules.
However, incorporating symmetry in cryo-EM data analysis poses significant mathematical and computational challenges, especially in the orientation estimation problem for 3-D ab initio modeling.
In particular, existing common-lines methods do not extend naturally to the symmetric case because the pairwise relative orientations are estimated up to arbitrary symmetry group elements, which in turn compromise the subsequent steps.
blocks.zh:
低温电子显微镜(cryo-EM)已作为一种强大的技术出现,用于在近原子分辨率下确定大分子的三维结构(Wang and Sigworth,2006.;Frank,2006.;Nakane等,2020.;Yip等,2020.).
对称性是自然界的一个根本特征,在蛋白质分子的结构组织上是普遍的.
然而,在低温-EM数据分析中纳入对称性,在数学和计算上构成重大的挑战,特别是在三维自始至终建模的定向估计问题上。
特别是,现有的通行法并不自然地延伸至对称性的情况,因为对等相对取向被估计到任意的对称性组元素,这反过来又会损害后续的步骤.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we tackle this problem by extending the non-unique games (NUG) framework ( Bandeira et al., 2020 ) to handle symmetric structures.
Our proposed computational framework provides a unified treatment for all symmetry groups rather than a case-by-case design as done in existing works.
More broadly, our framework addresses optimization problems over general compact groups from information about group offsets, covering many other important applications that include group synchronization and multi-reference alignment when the underlying signal has an intrinsic symmetric structure.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们通过扩展非独特游戏(NUG)框架(Bandeira等,2020年)来处理对称结构来解决这个问题.
我们提议的计算框架为所有对称群体提供了统一的处理方法,而不是在现有作品中所做的逐案设计。
更广泛地说,我们的框架从关于群体抵消的信息中解决了一般紧凑组的优化问题,涵盖许多其他重要的应用,包括群体同步和多参考对接,当基础信号具有内在对称结构时.

blocks.en:
The study of the orientation estimation problem dates back to the angular reconstitution method for non-symmetric molecules proposed by Vainshtein and Goncharov (1986) , Van Heel (1987) .
The crucial observation is that common lines between three images uniquely determine their relative orientations up to handedness.
The method proceeds in a sequential manner by estimating the relative orientation of a new image with respect to already estimated ones based on the common lines information.
Later, Farrow and Ottensmeyer (1992) proposed obtaining the relative orientation of a new image in a least squares fashion.
A major issue with these sequential methods are their reliance on correct detection of common lines, which is challenging in low signal-to-noise regimes, and the accumulation of the estimation error. Penczek et al. (1996) tried to circumvent this issue by estimating the orientations for all images simultaneously by minimizing a global energy functional.
However, this method is not very practical due to its overly large search space. Mallick et al. (2006) introduced a Bayesian approach where the common lines between a pair of images are determined from their common lines with different image triplets.
An issue of this approach is the requirement of correct identification of at least seven common lines simultaneously, rendering it not suitable when the detection rate of correct common lines is low.
An improved Bayesian approach was proposed by Singer et al. (2010) based on voting, which lowered the requirement to two common lines.
Further advancements were introduced in Singer and Shkolnisky (2011) , Shkolnisky and Singer (2012) based on semidefinite programming and synchronization approaches, leading to algorithms that are much more robust to noise.
blocks.zh:
方向估计问题的研究可追溯到由Vainshtein和Goncharov(1986年),Van Heel(1987年)提出的非对称分子角重构方法.
关键的观察是,三个图像之间的共同线条独一地决定着它们的相对取向,直到交接.
该方法通过根据共同线路信息估计新图像相对于已估计图像的相对取向,依次进行。
后来,Farrow和Ottensmeyer(1992年)提议以最不平方的方式获得新图像的相对取向.
这些相继方法的一个主要问题是它们依赖于对共同线路的正确探测,这在低信号到噪声的系统中是具有挑战性的,以及估计错误的积累. Penczek等人(1996年)试图通过尽量减少全球能功能,同时估计所有图像的取向来规避这一问题。
然而,这种方法并不十分实用,因为其搜索空间过大. Mallick等(2006年)引入了巴耶斯方法,一对图像之间的共同线由它们具有不同图像三相的同线来决定.
这种方法的一个问题是要求同时正确识别至少7条通线,因此当正确通线的检测率很低时是不合适的.
Singer等人(2010年)在表决的基础上提出了经改进的Bayesian方法,将要求降为两行。
在Singer和Shkolnisky(2011年),Shkolnisky和Singer(2012)中,基于半定时编程和同步方法引入了进一步的推进,导致算法更强而能产生噪音.

blocks.en:
The common-lines methods have made significant progress in solving the orientation estimation problem and demonstrated their empirical success on experimental datasets.
Nevertheless, there is still further room for improvement in that these methods do not fully exploit all the information contained in the images.
In particular, the methods mentioned above all take a two-step procedure by first computing the common lines (or a couple of top ones) and then estimating orientations that are most consistent with them.
This means that all information other than those contained in the detected common lines are discarded when estimating the orientations.
At low signal-to-noise ratios, the true common lines may not appear among the top ones detected, making them no longer available in the second step.
blocks.zh:
通线方法在解决取向估计上的问题上已取得重大进展,并展示了其在实验数据集上的经验成功.
然而,这些方法没有充分利用图像中的所有信息,仍有进一步改进的余地。
特别是上面提到的方法,先是计算出共同行(或几条上行),再估计出最符合它们的方向,就采取两步程序.
这意味着在估计方向时,除被检测出的共同行所包含信息外,其他所有信息都会被丢弃.
在低信号与噪声比率下,真实的通线可能不会出现在被检测出的最高通线中,使得第二步中它们不再可用.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this observation, Bandeira et al. (2020) proposed the NUG framework that estimates the orientations without explicit detection of common lines.
Precisely, the authors consider the following optimization problem min g 1 , … , g n ∈ 𝒢 ​ ∑ i , j = 1 n f i ​ j ​ ( g i ​ g j − 1 ) , \displaystyle\underset{g_{1},\ldots,g_{n}\in\mathcal{G}}{\operatorname{min}}\,\,\sum_{i,j=1}^{n}f_{ij}(g_{i}g_{j}^{-1}), (3) where 𝒢 = SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathcal{G}=\operatorname{SO}(3) and f i ​ j : 𝒢 → ℝ f_{ij}:\mathcal{G}\rightarrow\mathbb{R} is a measure of the agreement between the common lines in images I i I_{i} and I j I_{j} if their relative orientation was g i ​ g j − 1 g_{i}g_{j}^{-1} (see Section 4.1 for its precise form).
On a high level, the NUG framework searches for the orientations that maximize all pairwise agreement of common lines that would be implied by these orientations.
The algorithm only exploits the common lines implicitly and leverages full information contained in all images. Bandeira et al. (2020) exploits representation theory to first turn ( 3 ) into a matrix optimization problem with a linear objective min constraints on ​ X ​ ⟨ C , X ⟩ \displaystyle\underset{\text{constraints on }X}{\operatorname{min}}\,\,\langle C,X\rangle (4) for some matrix C C and X = X ⁡ ( g 1 , … , g n ) X=X(g_{1},\ldots,g_{n}) , followed by a semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation on the constraints.
The authors further demonstrated that the resulting algorithm is able to tolerate higher noise levels than other common-lines methods.

blocks.en:
It is worth mentioning that ( 3 ) provides a general framework for optimization over compact groups 𝒢 \mathcal{G} from information about group offsets.
The terminology non-unique games is motivated by the unique games problem in theoretical computer science ( Khot, 2002 , Khot, 2010 ) , which aims to solve a linear system over ℤ L \mathbb{Z}_{L} consisting of equations of the form x i − x j ≡ b i ​ j x_{i}-x_{j}\equiv b_{ij} with ≡ \equiv denoting equality modulo L L , for a set of pairs ( i , j ) ∈ T (i,j)\in T .
Once x i x_{i} is fixed, so is x j x_{j} for any j j such that ( i , j ) ∈ T (i,j)\in T , hence the name unique games.
This problem can be formulated as in ( 3 ) by setting 𝒢 = ℤ L \mathcal{G}=\mathbb{Z}_{L} and f i ​ j ​ ( g ) = − δ g ≡ b i ​ j f_{ij}(g)=-\delta_{g\equiv b_{ij}} as a Dirac delta function for ( i , j ) ∈ T (i,j)\in T and f i ​ j = 0 f_{ij}=0 otherwise.
For more general 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ’s and f i ​ j f_{ij} ’s, the original uniqueness property does not necessarily hold, leading to the non-unique games framework.
Other important problems that can be cast in the form of ( 3 ) include the semidefinite relaxation for the Max-Cut problem over ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} ( Goemans and Williamson, 1995 ) , angular synchronization over SO ⁡ ( 2 ) \operatorname{SO}(2) ( Singer, 2011 ) , multi-reference alignment over SO ⁡ ( 2 ) \operatorname{SO}(2) and SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{SO}(3) ( Bandeira et al., 2014 , Bandeira et al., 2020 ) , the little Grothendieck problem over the orthogonal group O ⁡ ( d ) \mathrm{O}(d) ( Bandeira et al., 2016 , Naor et al., 2013 ) , and many more.

blocks.zh: NUG 有对称

Linearity of ( 4 ) then implies that any convex combination of the solutions is again a solution, so that it is hopeless to recover the orientations g i g_{i} ’s from such an arbitrary solution X X to ( 4 ).
For this reason, it is imperative to extend the NUG framework to address symmetric structures.

blocks.en: Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款

blocks.en:
In this paper we introduce an SDP solution to ( 5 ) for general compact groups 𝒢 \mathcal{G} by extending the framework proposed in Bandeira et al. (2020) .
The new SDP relaxation is able to give a better computational complexity than the original one as symmetry can annihilate certain degrees in the irreducible representations of the group elements, leading to an SDP of smaller size.
We focus on the orientation estimation problem for symmetric molecules in cryo-EM, although our framework also covers other applications such as multi-reference alignment with symmetry.
The resulting algorithm returns accurate estimates of the orientations when moderate noise is present, and is shown to be effective in generating high-quality ab initio models from only a few class averages computed from experimental images of symmetric molecules.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们通过扩展Bandeira等人(2020年)提出的框架,对G\mathcal{G}一般紧凑组(5个)提出社发方案解决方案。
新的 SDP 放松能够给予比最初的更复杂的计算,因为对称性可以消灭群体元素不可减少的表示中的某些程度,从而导致规模更小的 SDP .
我们侧重于低温-EM中对称分子的取向估计问题,尽管我们的框架也涵盖其他应用,如多参考与对称相匹配.
由此产生的算法在存在中度噪声时返回对方向的准确估计,并被证明能有效从仅从对称分子的实验图像所计算的少数类平均值中产生出高质量的从头算起的模型.

blocks.en: Related Works
blocks.zh: 相关作品

blocks.en:
Few papers in the literature rigorously address the orientation estimation problem in the presence of symmetry.
Here we mention the line of works Pragier and Shkolnisky (2019) , Rosen and Shkolnisky (2020) , Geva and Shkolnisky (2023) which perform case-by-case studies to different symmetry groups covering cyclic, dihedral, octahedral and tetrahedral, and are inspired by Singer et al. (2010) , Singer et al. (2011) , Singer and Shkolnisky (2011) , Shkolnisky and Singer (2012) in the non-symmetric case.
Our work presents a unified mathematical framework that simultaneously covers all the discrete symmetries in SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{SO}(3) .
blocks.zh:
文献中很少有论文在对称性存在的情况下严格地论述取向估计问题.
在这里,我们提到了Pragier和Shkolnisky(2019年)、Rosen和Shkolnisky(2020年)、Geva和Shkolnisky(2023年)的著作,这些著作对包括自行车、双面、八面体和四面体的不同对称群体进行个案研究,并受到Singer等人(2010年)、Singer等人(2011年)、Singer和Shkolnisky(2011年)、Shkolnisky和Singer(2012)等非对称案件的启发。
我们的工作呈现了一个统一的数学框架,它同时覆盖了SO (3)\peratorname{SO}(3)中的所有离散对称.

blocks.en:
The rest of the paper is organized as follows.
In Section 2 , we introduce a semidefinite programming solution to ( 6 ).
In Section 3 , we discuss how to recover the Euler angles from the SDP solution.
Section 4 discusses practical considerations for implementation, followed by numerical experiments on both simulated and real datasets in Section 5 .

在第三节中,我们讨论了如何从社民党解决方案中恢复欧拉角度.
第4节讨论执行的实际考虑,然后在第5节中就模拟和实际数据集进行数字实验。

blocks.zh: Euler 角度恢复

blocks.en:
In this section we discuss how to recover the Euler angles { ( α i , β i , γ i ) } i = 1 n \{(\alpha_{i},\beta_{i},\gamma_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n} from the X X matrix obtained by solving the SDP ( 18 ).
One possible approach is by least squares, where one searches for the best pairs of Euler angles that would generate an X X that is closest to the SDP solution.
However, this approach is sensitive to the errors in the SDP solution and here we present a robust approach for the case of cyclic and dihedral symmetries by exploiting the special structures of the A k A_{k} ’s.

blocks.en: Truncation of Objective and Inequality Constraints via Fejér Kernel
blocks.zh: 通过Fejér Kernel减少目标和不平等限制

blocks.en:
We notice that both the SDP objective in ( 18 ) and the inequality constraints ( 16 ) involve an infinite series that needs to be truncated for implementation.
We shall simply truncate the objective function by ∑ k = 1 K Tr ⁡ [ C ( k ) ​ X ( k ) ] \sum_{k=1}^{K}\operatorname{Tr}[C^{(k)}X^{(k)}] for a suitable chosen K K .
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,社发方案的目标(18个)和不平等的制约因素(16个)都涉及一个无限系列,需要缩短执行。
我们只需将客观功能缩短为 \ k = 1 K Tr { [C (k) X (k) ]\ sum\ k = 1}} { Tr} [C\ (k) } { (k)} 适合选择的 K K 。

The situation for the inequality constraint, however, requires more careful treatment since the truncated series does not necessarily need to be nonnegative, leaving the validity of such empirical constraint questionable.

Numerical Experiments
blocks.zh: 数字实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we shall demonstrate the effectiveness of our symmetry NUG framework to the cryo-EM problem on both simulated and real datasets.
The code and data will be made publicly available upon publication through the ASPIRE open-source package ( Wright et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们将在模拟和真实数据集中展示我国对称的NUG框架对低温-EM问题的有效性。
守则和数据将在通过ASPIRE开放源码包(Wright等人,2023年)公布后公布。

blocks.en: Simulation Studies
blocks.zh: 模拟研究

blocks.en:
To start with, we consider simulated datasets generated from the base molecule EMD-2660 taken from the EMDB database ( Lawson et al., 2016 ) .
The original EMD-2660 molecule ϕ \phi does not have any symmetry, so we shall generate its symmetric versions by averaging itself with its symmetric transformations.
Precisely, for a symmetry group S S , generate ϕ S = 1 | S | ​ ∑ s ∈ S s ∘ ϕ , \displaystyle\phi_{S}=\frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{s\in S}s\circ\phi, which then has S S as its symmetry group.

最初的EMD-2660分子 \\phi 没有任何对称性,所以我们将通过它的对称性转化来平均生成它的对称性版本.
确切地说,对于对称组 S S ,生成 S = 1 S = 1 S = s = s = s = s = s ,\displaystyle\phi = s = s = frac{ 1 = s = s = s = s = s = s = in S}s\circ\phi, 由 S S 作为它的对称组 。

In particular, we are assuming perfectly centered images and ignoring the CTF effects here.
In this section, we shall use the ASPIRE-Python package ( Wright et al., 2023 ) for generating the projection images I i ∈ ℝ L × L I_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times L} , whose size is fixed to be L = 128 L=128 .

We shall test the performance of the NUG algorithm on recovering { R i } i = 1 N \{R_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} for different symmetry groups and signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), defined as SNR = Var(Signal) Var(Noise) . \displaystyle\text{SNR }=\frac{\text{Var(Signal)}}{\text{Var(Noise)}}. Figure 1 shows visualization of images with different SNRs generated by the original non-symmetric molecule EMD-2660.
The truncation level as discussed in Section 4.2 is set to be K = 12 K=12 throughout, with 𝒢 K \mathcal{G}_{K} containing 16317 elements that approximately form a uniform grid over SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{SO}(3) .
We remark that a larger truncation level leads to better approximation of the objective function, but at the cost of a larger SDP that is more costly and prone to numerical error.
The choice K = 12 K=12 is tuned empirically to achieve such a balance, beyond which no improvement is attained, and is observed to work well for all the considered cyclic and dihedral examples.

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 2 compare the performance of our proposed approach with the synchronization based approach proposed in Pragier and Shkolnisky (2019) .
The comparisons run across cyclic symmetries from C 1 C_{1} up to C 6 C_{6} with N = 40 N=40 and N = 100 N=100 , in terms of both the MSE ( 26 ) and the resolution as determined by the Fourier Shell Correlation (FSC) of the resulting reconstructed volumes.
We see that our algorithm returns fairly accurate viewing direction estimations for moderate noise levels and symmetry orders, and is more robust to noise.
The synchronization method outperforms ours in the clean case as expected in that synchronization exploits exact common lines geometry that becomes more accurate in the noiseless setting than the truncation-relaxation-rounding approximation in SDP approaches.
If instead the original NUG algorithm ( Bandeira et al., 2020 ) is applied to these symmetric molecules, we have observed that large MSEs are incurred even for clean images and the reconstructed molecule look visually very different from the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
表1和表2比较了我们拟议办法的执行情况和Pragier和Shkolnisky(2019年)提出的基于同步办法。
比较从C1 C_{1}到C6 C_{6}与N=40 N=40和N=100 N=100的循环对称,从MSE (26)和Fourier Shell Correlation(FSC)对所重建的卷的确定分辨率来看都是比较的.
我们看到,我们的算法对中等噪声水平和对称顺序的取景方向估计返回相当准确,对噪声更强.
同步方法在清洁的情况下比我们的业绩要好,因为同步利用了准确的普通线几何学,在无噪声的设定中,这些几何学比SDP方法中的截流-松动-圆相近更准确.
如果将最初的NUG算法(Bandeira等,2020年)应用于这些对称分子,我们观测到,即使是对于干净的图像来说,也会产生大型的MSE,被重建的分子看起来与地面的真理有很大的不同.

blocks.en:
We also note that the proximal refinement step is indeed able to improve the accuracy of the initial estimates, even by a significant amount in certain cases.
The performance starts to degrade as noise level becomes high and symmetry order is large.
We believe this is due to the fact that our SDP relaxation becomes less tight in such cases since we are dropping many low rank constraints that should be imposed on the diagonal blocks, which is exacerbated by high noise levels.
Nevertheless, we shall demonstrate on real datasets in the next subsection that when working with class averages which have much smaller noise level, our NUG framework is able to produce good ab initio models for symmetric molecules.
Tables 3 and 4 record the performance of our NUG approach for dihedral symmetries, where similar observations are made.
We note that Rosen and Shkolnisky (2020) considers orientation estimation for molecules with D 2 D_{2} symmetry and, to the best of our knowledge, is the only prior work addressing dihedral symmetry in this context. Our algorithm therefore provides a useful complementary approach.
blocks.zh:
我们还注意到,最近的改进步骤确实能够提高初步估计数的准确性,在某些情况下甚至可以提高相当数额。
性能随着噪声水平的提高而开始降解,对称顺序也很大.
我们认为,这是因为,在这种情况下,我们的社民党放松措施变得不那么严格,因为我们正在减少许多应当对对等地块施加的低级限制,而高噪音又加剧了这种限制。
然而,我们将在下分节中用真实的数据集证明,在与噪音水平小得多的班级平均值合作时,我们的NUG框架能够为对称分子产生良好的初始模型。
表3和表4记录了我国对二面体对称的NUG方法的性能,并提出了类似的观察.
我们注意到,Rosen和Shkolnisky(2020年)考虑用D2 D_{2}的对称性对分子进行取向估计,而且据我们所知,这是在这方面处理对称性的唯一前作。 因此,我们的算法提供了一个有益的补充方法。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
To close this section, we remark that one could also exclude the effects of self common lines by removing the diagonal losses f i ​ i f_{ii} ’s (cf. ( 22 )) from the objective function.
Our experiments suggest that whether the self common lines are excluded or not have small effects on the algorithmic performance.
Lastly, we present in Table 5 the computational time for solving the SDP ( 18 ) for different number of images, where the experiments are run on one A100 GPU with 80G memory.
The reported runtime corresponds to the C 2 C_{2} molecule, with comparable runtimes observed for the other symmetries tested.
In particular, the reported runtimes exclude proximal refinement. The total runtime should therefore be multiplied by five, since the refinement step requires four additional SDP solves.
We can see that the computational time scales roughly quadratically with the number of images.
The running times for the synchronization based algorithm depend on the noise level as well as the symmetry order due to specialized algorithms for C 2 , C 3 , C 4 C_{2},C_{3},C_{4} symmetries.
On a 2.8 GHz Intel CPU, they can vary between 10 ∼ \sim 100 minutes for N = 100 N=100 images and 110 ∼ \sim 1100 minutes for N = 300 N=300 images.
blocks.zh:
为了结束这一节,我们指出,也可以排除自我共同线的影响,从客观函数中去除对角损失fi i f_{ii (参见 (22)).
我们的实验表明,自通线是否被排除,对算法性能是否有小影响.
最后,我们在表5中列出不同数量图像的SDP(18)的解析计算时间,其中实验运行在一个具有80G内存的A100GPU上.
报告的运行时间对应C2 C_{2}分子,其他测试对称的运行时间可比较.
特别是,所报告的运行时间排除了近似改进。 因此,总运行时间应乘以5,因为完善步骤需要另外4个社会民主党解决方案。
我们可以看到,计算时间尺度与图像数量大致呈四相。
基于同步的算法的运行时间取决于噪声级别以及由C 2,C 3,C 4 C_{2},C_{3},C_{4}对称的专用算法导致的对称顺序.
在2.8千兆赫时 Intel CPU,它们可以在N=100 N=100图像的10 \\sim 100分钟和N=300 N=300图像的110 \\sim 1100分钟之间有所变化.

blocks.en: Experimental Datasets
blocks.zh: 实验数据集

blocks.en: EMPIAR-10081
blocks.zh: 埃姆皮亚尔-10081

blocks.en:
In this section, we shall apply our NUG framework on a real dataset with C 4 C_{4} symmetry taken from the EMPIAR-10081 entry from the EMPIAR image database ( Iudin et al., 2016 ) that contains 55870 raw images.
We use RELION ( Scheres, 2012 ) for generating 50 class averages from the original dataset.
Figure 2 shows several raw images from EMPIAR and the computed class averages.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们将将我们的NUG框架应用于一个真实数据集上,其中C 4 C_{4}对称性取自EMPIAR-10081条目,取自EMPIAR图像数据库(Iudin等,2016年),包含55870个原始图像.
我们使用RELION(Scheres,2012年)从原始数据集生成50个类平均值.
图2显示一些来自EMPIAR和计算类平均值的原始图像。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Raw images from EMPIAR 10081 (top) and class averages computed (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图2:来自EMPIAR 10081(上)和类平均值(下)的原始图像。

blocks.en: Out of the 50 class averages, we manually pick 17 of them that look visually meaningful, which are of size 256 by 256.
blocks.zh: 在50个班级平均数中,我们手动选取17个看起来有意义,大小256乘256的班级。

blocks.en:
We apply our NUG algorithm to obtain the orientation estimations for these 17 class averages, with truncation level K = 12 K=12 and 10 iterations of proximal refinement where in each iteration the projection rank is set to be rank ⁡ ( A k ) \operatorname{rank}(A_{k}) and the penalty is set to be η k = 1 k \eta_{k}=\frac{1}{k} .
The total computational time is about 20 minutes on an A100 GPU with 80G memory.
We then use the estimated orientations to build an ab initio model as displayed in Figure 3 .
We can see that even with only 17 images, our algorithm is able to yield a reasonably good reconstruction with a Fourier shell correlation (FSC) 15.45 A ̊ \mathring{A} with respect to the reference model (which we take as the reconstructed volume reported under the EMPIAR-10081 entry) as is shown in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
我们应用我们的NUG算法来获取这17个类平均值的取向估计,其中取出分流等级为K=12K=12和相近精细化的10个迭代,其中在每个迭代中,投影分级被设定为QQ(A k)\operatorname{rank}(A_{k}),罚分被设定为QK=1克\eta_{k}=\frac{ 1}{k} 。 。 。 。
A100GPU上的总计算时间约为20分钟,有80G内存.
然后,我们利用估计的方向来构建图3所示的初始模型。
我们可以看到,即使只有17个图像,我们的算法仍能够以傅里叶外壳相干性(FSC)15.45 A\\ mathring{A}对参考模型(我们把它当作在EMPIAR-10081条目下报告的重建体积)进行合理的良好重建,如图4所示。

blocks.en: We then feed this ab initio model into CryoSPARC ( Punjani et al., 2017 ) for refinement using all the raw images and arrive at the model shown in Figure 3 with an FSC of 7.97 A ̊ \mathring{A} , suggesting our ab initio reconstruction is reasonably accurate for iterative refinement to work.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将这一初始模型输入CryoSPARC(Punjani等,2017年),以便利用所有原始图像进行改进,并得出图3中显示的模型,FSC为7.97 A\mathring{A},这表明我们的初始重建对于迭代改进工作来说是相当准确的。

blocks.en: EMPIAR-12036
blocks.zh: EMPIAR-12036号

blocks.en:
Next we shall apply our NUG algorithm to another experimental dataset with D 3 D_{3} symmetry taken from the EMPIAR-12036 entry from the EMPIAR image database containing 1565602 raw images.
We again apply RELION to generate 93 class averages of size 128 by 128 as visualized in Figure 5 after discarding those that are visually uninterpretable.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将将我们的NUG算法应用于另一个实验数据集,其中D 3 D_{3}对称取自EMPIAR-12036条目,取自EMPIAR图像数据库中包含1565602原始图像.
我们再次应用RELION,在丢弃那些视线无法解释的后,生成图5中可视化的93等平均值128乘128。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Raw images from EMPIAR 12036 (top) and class averages computed (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图5:来自EMPIAR 12036(上)和类平均值(下)的原始图像。

blocks.en:
We apply our NUG algorithm to obtain the orientation estimations for these 93 class averages, with truncation level K = 12 K=12 and 5 iterations of proximal refinement where in each iteration the projection rank is set to be rank ⁡ ( A k ) \operatorname{rank}(A_{k}) and the penalty is set to be η k = 1 k \eta_{k}=\frac{1}{k} .
The total running time is about 2 hours on an A100 GPU with 80G memory.
The estimated orientations are used to build an ab initio model as displayed in Figure 6 , yielding
a reconstruction with a Fourier shell correlation (FSC) 26.60 A ̊ \mathring{A} with respect to the volume reported under the 12036 entry as is shown in Figure 7 .
This ab initio model is then imported into CryoSPARC ( Punjani et al., 2017 ) for refinement using all the raw images and we obtain the refined model as shown in Figure 6 with an FSC of 10.72 A ̊ \mathring{A} .
The experiment as well as that in the previous subsection suggests the applicability of our approach to experimental datasets.
blocks.zh:
我们运用我们的NUG算法来获得这93个类平均值的取向估计,其中分流等级为K = 12 K = 12和5次相近的修饰,其中在每次修饰中,投影分级被设定为QQ (A k)\operatorname{rank}(A_{k}),罚分被设定为QK = 1 k\eta_{k}=\frac{ 1}{k} 。 。 。 。
总运行时间为A100GPU上约2小时,内存为80G.
估计方向用于构建图6所示的初始模型,产生
a 与图7所示的12036条目下报告的体积有关的重建,FSC 26.60 A\ mathring{A}。
这一自始至终的模型随后被导入CryoSPARC(Punjani等,2017年),以便利用所有原始图像进行精细化,我们获得了图6所示精细模型,FSC为10.72。 一个\\ mathring{A}。
实验以及上分节的实验表明,我们的方法适用于实验数据集。
